provenance: Transcribed by Claude on 2026-10-28 for Checkpoint 3; not yet verified by the author. Only the courses the demo student's record needs, so the B.A. degree requirements have something to count. Checked by Claude on 2026-10-28 against the extracted catalog text: titles, credits, areas and prerequisite notes all match. Author sign-off still pending.

conventions.scope: Stubs, not a curated department: id, title, credits and Exploratory Foundations area only. Prerequisites are left null (JAPN 152 really requires JAPN 151); nothing downstream depends on them.
conventions.distribution: The area the catalog prints first. Where it prints 'X-or-Y' (e.g. 'Arts and Humanities-or-Global Learning'), Y goes in attributes; the degree requirements mark those areas exclusive, so the course fills one of the two, never both.
conventions.FYS: Courses numbered 197 titled 'First-Year Seminar' carry the attribute FYS. The catalog prints no area for them.
conventions.area_codes: AH Arts and Humanities, SM Science and Mathematics, SS Social Science, LA Language, GL Global Learning, PPD Power, Privilege and Diversity (course listings print it 'Privilege, Power And Diversity')
